title_tag: Balinese Facial: Traditional Bali Skincare with Turmeric & Clay
meta: What is a Balinese facial? The island's beauty traditions, turmeric, clay, rose and aloe, and two natural Balinese facial rituals you can book in Uluwatu.
intro: Long before serums and machines, Balinese women cared for their skin with what grew around them: turmeric, rice, clay, coconut, flowers and aloe. A Balinese facial brings these island traditions into a modern treatment room. If you want a natural, sensory facial that feels like Bali, this guide is for you.
body_html:
Bali's beauty traditions

  • Turmeric (kunyit): used for centuries for a bright, even complexion; also a key spice in boreh, the traditional Balinese warming body scrub.
  • Rice: ground into powders to polish and soften the skin.
  • Volcanic and natural clays: to absorb oil and purify.
  • Frangipani and rose: flower petals in water and oils, for softness and scent.
  • Coconut oil and aloe: to soothe skin after a day in the sun.

These rituals were part of daily life and ceremonies, and they still shape how Balinese therapists touch and care for the skin today.

Our two Balinese facial rituals

At Point Face, our two natural rituals are made with products from Utama Spice, a skincare brand made in Bali:

Hydrating Ritual – Rose & Aloe (45 min) Double cleansing, gentle enzyme exfoliation, aloe hydration mask, rose toner, rose serum infusion, cooling massage and a moisture shield. Ideal after the beach, for dry, tired or sun-exposed skin.

Purifying Ritual – Clay & Turmeric (60 min) Deep cleansing, natural scrub, blackhead removal, Balinese clay mask, witch hazel toner, jojoba serum with massage, and a hydration finish. Ideal for oily, congested or dull skin.

Balinese facial vs Korean facial

Balinese ritual Korean Hydrafacial
Approach Natural ingredients, hands-on massage Technology + active serums
Feeling Relaxing, sensory, warm Clinical-clean, results-driven
Duration 45–60 min 70–80 min
Best for First facial, relaxation, holiday treat Visible glow, pores, firmness, acne-prone skin

Many guests start with a Balinese ritual and switch to a Korean facial on their next visit, or combine both during a long stay.

Make it a Bali self-care afternoon

Pair your ritual with a Kobido or Gua Sha face massage, or add our Collagen Eye Ritual and Lip Scrub Ritual at no extra time. Then head to a cliff bar in Uluwatu for sunset.
